rationale: S-0069-01 proposes halving somatic gnabar_HHst before attaching the AIS, then re-running the t0069 sweep, on the hypothesis that a weakened soma lets the AIS dominate spike initiation. t0075 (bio_realistic_ais_param_sweep) covers this directly as Stage 2 axis 1: soma gnabar_HHst is swept across {100, 200, 300, 400} mS / cm^2 at the literature-informed AIS baseline. Stage 1 of t0075 also explicitly searches for a soma-gnabar value that lands the cell inside {peak Hz in [5, 50], DSI in [0.3, 0.95]}, which is exactly the regime S-0069-01 was probing. Rejecting as covered.
